subject.title: fix: stabilize embedded prompt caching across policy and Responses boundaries

question: Should owner-only protected tool schemas remain model-visible to unauthorized turns when immutable turn grants and pre-execution gates deny all calls?
rationale: This PR intentionally replaces part of the existing schema-filtering boundary with stable visibility plus runtime denial; tests can prove enforcement but cannot decide whether that information and policy boundary is acceptable.

options.title: Accept Stable Visibility
options.body: Keep schemas visible and require exhaustive proof that every native, plugin, CLI, remote-node, and MCP path denies unauthorized calls before hooks or side effects.

options.title: Preserve Schema Filtering
options.body: Keep protected schemas absent for unauthorized turns and solve cache continuity without changing the visibility boundary.

options.title: Approve A Narrow Subset
options.body: Expose only specifically approved protected schemas while retaining filtering for higher-risk tools.

recommendation.title: Accept Stable Visibility
recommendation.body: Keep schemas visible and require exhaustive proof that every native, plugin, CLI, remote-node, and MCP path denies unauthorized calls before hooks or side effects.

likelyOwner.reason: The most recent adjacent current-main work covers bundled MCP, remote-node execution, and Gateway tool-policy enforcement, which are central to this choice.
